And after the verbs which take the words इतरेतर 'each other' and अन्योन्य 'one another', as उपपद (or dependant qualifying words), the affixes of आत्मनेपद are not used, though reciprocity of action be denoted.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

In the परस्मैपद affixes the इ is optionally elided in the लेट् (Vedic Subjunctive).

Terms: लेट्

And there is elision of the इ of that परस्मैपद affix which is the substitute of a ल having an indicatory ङ्।

Terms: ल

The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after a dissyallabic प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in short इ , but not, however after a word ending in the Patronymic affix इञ्।

Terms: ढक्

The above affixes are seen coming after किम् , a सर्वनाम and बहु ending with other case-affixes also besides the Locative -7th case and Ablative -5th case.

Terms: किम्
